name: checkins_active_member
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX checkins_active_member ON finfolk.checkins USING btree (user_id) WHERE ((checked_in_at IS NOT NULL) AND (checked_out_at IS NULL))

name: checkins_beach_recent
definition: CREATE INDEX checkins_beach_recent ON finfolk.checkins USING btree (beach_id, visit_day, user_id)

name: directory_owner
definition: CREATE INDEX directory_owner ON finfolk.directory_listings USING btree (owner_id)

name: directory_pending_claim
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX directory_pending_claim ON finfolk.directory_claims USING btree (listing_id, user_id) WHERE (state = 'pending'::text)

name: directory_public
definition: CREATE INDEX directory_public ON finfolk.directory_listings USING btree (status, lower((document ->> 'name'::text)), id)

name: environment_job_due
definition: CREATE INDEX environment_job_due ON finfolk.environment_jobs USING btree (next_attempt_at)

name: environment_snapshot_retention

name: environment_snapshot_target
definition: CREATE INDEX environment_snapshot_target ON finfolk.environment_snapshots USING btree (target_id, retrieved_at DESC)

name: instagram_actions_owner

name: instagram_commands_owner

name: instagram_commands_post

name: instagram_commands_recent

name: instagram_commands_send
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_commands_send ON finfolk.instagram_commands USING btree (updated_at) WHERE (send_state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'sending'::text, 'uncertain'::text]))

name: instagram_commands_sender
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_commands_sender ON finfolk.instagram_commands USING btree (namespace, actor_id, received_at DESC)

name: instagram_commands_sent_recent
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_commands_sent_recent ON finfolk.instagram_commands USING btree (send_started_at DESC) WHERE (send_started_at IS NOT NULL)

name: instagram_comment_connection

name: instagram_connect_sender

name: instagram_connected_handle
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instagram_connected_handle ON finfolk.instagram_connections USING btree (lower(handle)) WHERE (status = 'connected'::text)

name: instagram_discovery_feed
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_discovery_feed ON finfolk.instagram_discoveries USING btree (beach_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (state = 'published'::text)

name: instagram_discovery_owner
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_discovery_owner ON finfolk.instagram_discoveries USING btree (owner_id, created_at DESC)

name: instagram_discovery_review
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_discovery_review ON finfolk.instagram_discoveries USING btree (created_at) WHERE (state = 'pending'::text)

name: instagram_dm_claim
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_dm_claim ON finfolk.instagram_dm_events USING btree (challenge_hash, sender_id)

name: instagram_dm_owner
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_dm_owner ON finfolk.instagram_dm_events USING btree (owner_id) WHERE (owner_id IS NOT NULL)

name: instagram_dm_pending
definition: CREATE INDEX instagram_dm_pending ON finfolk.instagram_dm_events USING btree (status, created_at)

name: instagram_media_owner
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instagram_media_owner ON finfolk.instagram_connections USING btree (media_owner_id) WHERE (media_owner_id IS NOT NULL)

name: instagram_sender_scope
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instagram_sender_scope ON finfolk.instagram_connections USING btree (provider_scope, sender_id) WHERE (sender_id IS NOT NULL)

name: media_imports_inbox
definition: CREATE INDEX media_imports_inbox ON finfolk.media_imports USING btree (owner_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE ((session_id IS NULL) AND (state = 'active'::text))

name: media_imports_session
definition: CREATE INDEX media_imports_session ON finfolk.media_imports USING btree (session_id) WHERE (session_id IS NOT NULL)

name: messaging_events_work
definition: CREATE INDEX messaging_events_work ON finfolk.instagram_dm_events USING btree (processing_state, next_attempt_at)

name: messaging_outbox_work
definition: CREATE INDEX messaging_outbox_work ON finfolk.messaging_outbox USING btree (state, next_attempt_at)

name: posts_public_feed
definition: CREATE INDEX posts_public_feed ON finfolk.posts USING btree (beach_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE ((status = 'approved'::text) AND public_consent)

name: posts_review_queue
definition: CREATE INDEX posts_review_queue ON finfolk.posts USING btree (status, created_at DESC)

name: sessions_owner_beach

name: site_revisions_status_idx

name: trip_import_trip

name: trips_owner
definition: CREATE INDEX trips_owner ON finfolk.trips USING btree (owner_id, updated_at DESC)

name: trips_public_beach
definition: CREATE INDEX trips_public_beach ON finfolk.trips USING btree (((published ->> 'beachId'::text)), published_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (published IS NOT NULL)
